absent: Enabled ACPI behavior, error paths beyond fallbacks, and any locking, sleeping or calling context requirements.
Whole table versus subtable probe dispatch order, validation failure handling, and driver data lifetime.
IORT mapping, translation and reservation algorithms and their synchronization.
Power management timer port discovery, verification method and wrap around handling.
AGP aperture binding lifecycle, memory allocation failure modes and concurrency rules.
Asynchronous IO cancellation protocol and address space teardown side effects.
APM BIOS register calling convention, error returns and event polling semantics.
Numeric annotation type values and how consumers interpret them.

findings.text: When the corresponding ACPI support is unavailable the operating system capabilities accessors report no PCI or CXL control, sleep state queries report unsupported, processor handle lookup yields no handle, the MRRM region limit is one, and the CMOS RTC platform device presence flag is false.
The extended linear cache size helper for heterogeneous memory reports operation not supported and leaves the output size untouched.
The IOAPIC addition helper is an always successful no effect operation.

The low power S0 idle device operations record contains a list linkage for registration plus three optional callbacks corresponding to prepare, check and restore phases, each taking no arguments and returning nothing.
Low power S0 idle device registration reports missing device without side effects while unregistration silently does nothing.
The prepare sleep setter is defined as an empty do while construct that evaluates to nothing and ignores its function and control arguments.

Runtime suspend and resume subsystem hooks plus device power management attach always report success, storage devices are reported as not requiring the deepest sleep state, and devices are reported as already in the fully on state.

System wide power transition hooks for prepare, complete, late suspend, no interrupt suspend, normal suspend, freeze, power off and early restore are trivial; the completion hook has no effect and all others report success.
Embedded controller general purpose event wake marking and wake mask configuration are no effect operations.
Handle based diagnostic printing and evaluation failure warning helpers accept level, handle, name, status and format arguments but produce no output and have no observable effect.

Severity helpers from emergency through info forward handle and format arguments to the shared handle printer with the matching kernel log level. Debug has three build dependent forms: direct forwarding, dynamic call site dispatch, and a disabled form that evaluates its arguments in dead code and yields zero.

General purpose input output resource classifiers for interrupt and input output descriptors always report no match. Lookup of an interrupt with wake capability by connection identifier always fails with missing device address.
Convenience interrupt getters delegate to the by name wake capable lookup, supplying a null connection identifier or a null wake capability pointer when the caller does not provide them.

In the enabled build the firmware node property reference accessor forwards to an internal helper with a fixed maximum argument count. The internal helper itself reports missing address when unavailable.

Device property fetch, the disabled build property reference accessor, generic property value fetch, and remote endpoint lookup all report missing address, while next endpoint iteration reports a missing address error pointer.
A device is considered to carry firmware properties exactly when its properties list is not empty.

The table probe entry holds a short table identifier, a subtype code, a subtable validation callback, a choice between a whole table handler and a subtable entry handler, and opaque driver data. The validator receives a subtable header and reports acceptance as a boolean.
The ACPI probe table identifier length is five bytes.

Enabled probe declaration macros emit a constant entry into a per table linker section, selecting the whole table member or the subtable member as appropriate, with table and end symbols marking the array bounds and a scan helper deriving the entry count from the bounds. Disabled builds instead emit an unused pointer array capturing the macro arguments and define table scanning as an immediate zero.

Table upgrade, watchdog presence, serial port console table parsing, interrupt resource fetch and affinity, low power idle residency address read, and architecture idle flag translation have fixed fallback outcomes: upgrade does nothing, watchdog is absent, serial parsing reports missing device, interrupt fetch reports invalid argument with null affinity, residency read reports invalid argument, and idle flag translation yields zero.

Processor properties topology thread and level lookups report invalid argument, cache level and cache to mask lookups report missing entry, container to mask conversion does nothing, platform communication channel and fixed function hardware initialization do nothing, device notification attach and detach do nothing, use of the parent companion assigns the parent companion to the child, and proximity domain backing reports false.

An IORT interrupt value carries the identifier in the low thirty two bits and trigger information in the high thirty two bits. SMMU version three performance monitor group model identifiers are zero for generic, one for HiSilicon HIP08 and two for HiSilicon HIP09.

Without IORT support message interrupt mapping and translation are identity, translation of interrupt controller addresses and platform message interrupt information report missing device, domain lookup yields null, platform domain configuration and reserved memory and reservation region collection do nothing, direct memory access range and identifier configuration report missing device, and the maximum direct memory access address is the largest physical address.

The ACPI power management timer runs at three million five hundred seventy nine thousand five hundred forty five ticks per second, exposes only the low twenty four bits of its counter, and overflows at one shifted left by twenty four.
Early power management timer read returns zero when the port is unset or when support is compiled out; otherwise it returns the verified counter value masked to the valid bit width.

The ADFS block checker validates a five hundred twelve byte block by folding all but the last byte into an eight bit accumulated sum with carry folding and reports mismatch when the result differs from the stored check byte.

Accelerated graphics port support distinguishes unsupported from supported chipsets, versions carry major and minor numbers, kernel information aggregates version, PCI device, chipset, mode, aperture base and size, memory limits, aperture usability, page mask and virtual memory operations, and each memory segment links forward and backward, references its bridge, page array and count, key, scratch count, aperture offset, type, physical address, bound and flushed flags, mapped list linkage and scatter gather list with entry count.

Normal graphics aperture memory uses type zero while user memory types reside at sixty five thousand five hundred thirty six and above, with plain user memory at the base and cached user memory one higher.
An asynchronous input output cancellation function receives a control block pointer and reports an integer status.
Asynchronous input output teardown for an address space and installation of a cancellation callback are no effect operations in this configuration.

AMD input output memory management detection, secure nested paging disable and guest address logging and guest mode transitions report success without effect, while secure encrypted virtualization trusted input output support is reported as unavailable.

Annotation helpers emit a discard section record holding a relative offset to a label and a numeric annotation type. String builders provide label addressed, current instruction addressed and current data addressed forms for instruction versus data annotation sections.

Convenience markers designate code without end branch, retpoline safe sequences, ignored alternatives, intra function calls, unreachable tolerant regions, function reachability, symbols exempt from control flow integrity, data requiring special handling, and paired begin and end delimiters for instrumented and unreturnable ranges.
Advanced power management information aggregates firmware description, connection version, power status quirks, interrupt and idle permissions, real mode power off capability and a disabled flag.

APM code and data selectors derive from the APM BIOS base entry scaled by eight with eight byte spacing between successive selectors. Capability bits use values one, two, four, eight and sixteen for sixteen bit, thirty two bit, slow idle, disabled and disengaged states. BIOS services are twenty sequential values starting at hex fifty three hundred for install check and incrementing by one through timer services. Timer, resume ring and timer control subfunctions use zero for disable, one for enable or get depending on group, and two for get or set.
Each examined header defines a unique include protection macro preventing multiple inclusion.
Property presence testing relies on an external list emptiness helper owned by another dossier.
